local_audio_loop.reference_text: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
local_audio_loop.scope: One synthetic local TTS endpoint to STT endpoint loop; no physical playback, microphone, acoustic listening, realtime-client latency, or quality preference result.
local_audio_loop.stt_hypothesis: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

native_cache_inventory.claim_boundary: Point-in-time metadata inventory only. It does not establish upstream completeness, eliminate filesystem races, or make the whole cache safe.

audio_evidence_path_guard.environment_mechanism_boundary: The successful envelope proves the path was accepted and the artifact written. It does not itself record the caller working directory or ANVIL_BENCHMARK_EVIDENCE_DIR value.
audio_evidence_path_guard.message: voice benchmark: artifact_path must be inside the workspace or configured evidence directory
audio_evidence_path_guard.source_order_observation: Reviewed voice/cli.py resolves the evidence path before manifest-success output and before run_audio_benchmark_from_manifest. The envelopes do not attest their executed CLI source or working directory, so the source-order claim is bounded to the reviewed source identity.

realtime_protocol_smoke.scope: Exact authenticated two-text-turn transcript/terminal/correlation/nonempty-PCM protocol smoke plus unauthenticated rejection.

scope_limits: No subjective acoustic or listening judgment.
No physical speaker playback, microphone input, playback interruption/cancellation, or full UI/client exercise.
No 100-turn or 1200-second soak and no continuous endpoint/protected-process monitoring.
No full retained-control requalification, candidate promotion, shipped-integration approval, or external publication authorization.
The single zero-WER loop is a functional smoke and cannot replace corpus quality evidence.

service_restoration.endpoint_probe_boundary: Two unloaded LLM rows report endpoint_reachable=true/http404 because endpoint probing is port based; this is not evidence those candidate supervisors are loaded. Supervisor PID/registered/running/state fields are the lifecycle authority.
